printer_paper_jam_check.title: Is there visible paper stuck in the printer?
printer_paper_jam_check.subtitle: Open the printer cover and check for crumpled or jammed paper.

printer_paper_jam_fix.title: Clear the Paper Jam
instructions: Power off the printer using the power button.
Open all access panels and gently pull out jammed paper — always pull toward the paper exit, never backward.
Remove any torn scraps. Use tweezers if needed.
Reload the paper roll so the paper feeds from the bottom.
Close all panels, then power the printer back on.
Print a test page using the button on the back of the unit.

printer_internal_jam_fix.title: Internal Jam — Roller Check
instructions: Power off the printer.
Use a flashlight to inspect the paper path — look for small torn bits of paper.
Use tweezers to remove any fragments found.
Clean the paper sensor (small clear tab near the roller) with a dry cotton swab.
Reload paper and power on. Try a test print.

printer_power_check.title: Are the power and status lights on?
printer_power_check.subtitle: Check that the green or blue power indicator is lit.

printer_power_fix.title: Restore Printer Power
instructions: Check that the power cable is fully seated in both the printer and the wall outlet.
Try a different outlet to rule out a dead circuit.
Hold the power button for 5 seconds to force a reset.
If using a power strip, bypass it and plug directly into the wall.

printer_cable_check.title: Is the USB or Ethernet cable firmly connected?
printer_cable_check.subtitle: Trace the cable from the printer to the POS terminal or router.

printer_reconnect_fix.title: Re-seat the Cable
instructions: Unplug the data cable from both ends.
Inspect the connector for bent pins or debris.
Firmly re-seat the cable at both ends until you hear/feel a click.
Attempt a test print from the POS.

printer_driver_restart_fix.title: Restart the Print Service
instructions: On the POS terminal, close the restaurant software.
Reboot the POS terminal completely.
Power-cycle the printer: off for 10 seconds, then on.
Re-open the restaurant software and try a test print.

printer_garbled_check.title: Did the issue start after a software update?
printer_garbled_check.subtitle: Check with your manager if any updates were applied today.

printer_garbled_update_fix.title: Driver Mismatch After Update
instructions: Reboot the POS terminal.
Open Settings → Printers and confirm the correct driver is selected for your model.
If the driver changed, select the previous driver or re-install from the USB stick in the manager's office.
Run a test print.

printer_garbled_cable_fix.title: Data Corruption — Cable or Port
instructions: Replace the USB cable with the spare from the supply cabinet.
Try a different USB port on the POS terminal.
Power-cycle both the printer and the POS.
Run a test print.

printer_paper_out_fix.title: Reload Paper Roll
instructions: Open the printer lid.
Remove the empty core from the spindle.
Place a new 80mm thermal roll with paper feeding from the bottom of the roll.
Leave about 2 inches of paper hanging out, then close the lid firmly.
The printer will auto-calibrate and be ready to print.

pos_triage.title: What is the POS doing?
pos_triage.subtitle: Select the best description of the issue.

pos_reboot_fix.title: Reboot the POS Terminal
instructions: Hold the power button for 10 seconds until the screen goes dark.
Wait 30 seconds.
Press the power button once to restart.
Wait for the POS software to fully load (up to 2 minutes).

pos_card_check.title: Is the card reader cable seated correctly?
pos_card_check.subtitle: Trace the cable from the card swipe to the back of the POS.

pos_card_clean_fix.title: Clean the Card Reader
instructions: Use a dry microfiber cloth to wipe the card slot opening.
Insert and remove a cleaning card 3 times (spare in manager's drawer).
Retry a card transaction.
pos_card_clean_fix.resolvedPrompt: Is the card reader working now?

pos_card_reseat_fix.title: Re-seat Card Reader Cable
instructions: Power off the POS terminal.
Unplug and re-seat the USB or serial cable from the card reader.
Power the terminal back on and retry.
pos_card_reseat_fix.resolvedPrompt: Is the card reader working now?

pos_slow_fix.title: Speed Up the POS
instructions: Close any browser windows or extra applications running in the background.
Reboot the terminal.
Ensure the Wi-Fi signal indicator shows 3+ bars, or switch to wired Ethernet.
If on Wi-Fi, move the router/access point closer or remove obstructions.

pos_serial_number.title: Enter the POS Terminal Serial Number
pos_serial_number.prompt: Found on the label on the back or bottom of the terminal.

kds_triage.title: What is the Kitchen Display doing?
kds_triage.subtitle: Select the best description of the issue.

kds_power_fix.title: Restore KDS Display
instructions: Check the power cable and display cable at the back of the unit.
Press the menu button on the back and confirm Brightness is not set to 0.
Power-cycle the KDS unit.
kds_power_fix.resolvedPrompt: Is the screen showing content now?

kds_network_fix.title: Reconnect KDS to Network
instructions: Check the Ethernet cable between the KDS and the network switch.
Reboot the network switch by unplugging for 30 seconds.
Reboot the KDS unit.
Confirm orders are routing correctly from the POS.

kds_touch_fix.title: Restore Touchscreen Response
instructions: Clean the screen with a dry microfiber cloth.
Ensure no water or grease is coating the screen.
Reboot the KDS unit.
Test touch response on the home screen.

kds_serial_number.title: Enter the KDS Serial Number
kds_serial_number.prompt: Found on the label on the back of the display unit.

kiosk_triage.title: What is the Kiosk doing?
kiosk_triage.subtitle: Select the best description of the issue.

kiosk_reboot_fix.title: Reboot the Kiosk
instructions: Locate the power button on the back panel of the kiosk cabinet.
Hold for 10 seconds to force shutdown.
Wait 30 seconds, then press once to restart.
Wait for the welcome screen to appear (up to 3 minutes).
kiosk_reboot_fix.resolvedPrompt: Is the kiosk showing the welcome screen?

kiosk_serial_number.title: Enter the Kiosk Serial Number
kiosk_serial_number.prompt: Found on the asset tag inside the kiosk cabinet door.

other_triage.title: What type of equipment needs support?
other_triage.subtitle: Choose the closest match.

other_network_fix.title: Network / Wi-Fi Reset
instructions: Locate the router or access point (usually mounted near the manager's office or above the POS area).
Unplug the power cable from the router for 60 seconds.
Plug it back in and wait 2 minutes for it to fully reconnect.
Test connectivity on the POS terminal.

other_cash_fix.title: Cash Drawer Not Opening
instructions: Verify the RJ-11 cable between the cash drawer and the receipt printer is connected.
In the POS software, trigger an 'Open Cash Drawer' command from the admin menu.
If the drawer still won't open, use the emergency key on the bottom of the drawer.

other_serial_number.title: Enter Equipment Serial or Asset Number
other_serial_number.prompt: Found on the asset tag or label on the equipment.
